01-hook.text: Every city wants more EV chargers. Few can show where the first ones should go, and why.

03-study.text: We screened twelve public sites in Northern Virginia on four published parts: demand, feasibility, safety and equity.

04-stable.text: Then we reweighted the model two thousand times, to show how sure each rank really is.

05-yours.text: Now it's your turn. Bring a spreadsheet of your own sites.

06-device.text: The planner matches your columns and runs the model right in your browser. Your file never leaves your device.

07-results.text: See every site ranked, exactly why it scored that way, and download a council-ready report in one click.

07b-more.text: Fill gaps with public data, ask the built-in assistant, and keep planning even offline.

08-cta.text: EV-SIENT. Plan smarter charging with your own data. Try it free today.
